result.topic_en: Brief formula notes on a definite integral involving a square root of a quadratic in s and the factor c^2+s, followed by two rational expressions in a, b, c, s.

methods.what: Definite integral over s from 0 to infinity with an inverse square root of a quadratic in s and a factor 1/(c^2+s)
Rational expression in s combining the factors a^2+s, b^2+s, c^2+s (minus-sign variant)
Rational expression in s combining the factors a^2+s, b^2+s, c^2+s (plus-sign variant)
